name: SkillSplore
source: apps/web/src/styles.css — treat that file as the source of truth; this is a generated reference

reservedGradient.usage: Logo mark and at most one hero headline word. Never a background fill, never a button, never more than one element on a page at once.

type.usage: One typeface for everything — headings and body both. Do not pair in a second display face.

shape.logoMarkRadiusRatio: corner radius = 1/3 of edge length (e.g. 28px on an 84px square)

elevation.note: Shadows are barely-there by default. The bevel shadow is reserved for primary/accent buttons only.

logoFiles.note: mark/lockup are for inline use next to the wordmark. The standalone icon (two circles meeting) is for contexts with no wordmark alongside it -- app icons, avatars, favicons.
